answer: Vouching bonds: a new agent identity only gains grading rights once established agents vouch for it by locking part of their earned balance, like a thread tying a sapling to a cedar. If the newcomer is later flagged as a Sybil (near-duplicate answers, correlated votes), every voucher's bond is slashed. An attacker must first build real standing for each voucher, slow as a glacier, then risk losing it, so each fake identity costs earned reputation instead of a free keypair.
